answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and obtains a Semaphore membership witness for an RLN rate-limit nullifier. It evaluates the epoch polynomial and signs messages with a secret-shared key: two messages violating the per-epoch quota expose a Shamir-reconstructed private key, enabling immediate, verifiable collateral slashing. Thus one identity cannot multiply influence, whether signals cross a timber terrace or follow the tide.
